features: Five existing geometry/confidence features plus 2/3/5-observation bounded-lookahead confirmation flags. No reference inputs. Up to four future contiguous frames. No forecast promoted to measurement.
training: Game 4 only, maximum reference IoU >=0.5 positive, <=0.1 negative; intermediate and unknown/ignored frames excluded. Equal total training weight per clip/mode. Separate geometry-only models form an ablation.
selection: Among temporal models retaining >=95% of raw matches and removing >=20% unmatched in each validation mode, choose pooled F1 then matches then fewer unmatched. Freeze before game 9. Same gates on recheck; no retuning. No recheck if validation fails. Geometry-only ablation is descriptive, not a fallback release.
limits: Same previously exposed short external clips, not independent testing. Only labeled nonignored ball-present targets. In-play identity, absent-ball, temporal identity accuracy and possession unvalidated. A pass permits broader external evaluation only. The previous hard-filter experiment remains failed.
